page.content:
Cartographer who drew the Mid-Atlantic Ridge rift valley.

How Marie Tharp connects

  • Location: Mid-Atlantic Ridge — Marie Tharp drew the rift valley that revealed the Mid-Atlantic Ridge as a spreading center.
  • Character: Bruce Heezen — Heezen collected the soundings Tharp assembled into seafloor maps.
  • Faction: Lamont–Doherty Earth Observatory — Tharp mapped the ocean floor at Lamont.

What is Marie Tharp?

Marie Tharp, working with Bruce Heezen at Columbia, mapped a continuous rift down the Mid-Atlantic Ridge and made seafloor spreading visible on paper.

Key threads lead to Mid-Atlantic Ridge, Bruce Heezen and Lamont–Doherty Earth Observatory.
